parts.prompt: A gym charges a 13-dollar sign-up fee plus 23 dollars per month. The total cost for 4 friends who each stay n months is 4(23n + 13). Write the total cost in expanded form.
A price p is raised by 50% and the result is then raised by 20%. The final price is 1.2(1.5p). Write the final price as a single term.
An order of 3 identical boxes costs 3x + 6 dollars in all, where x is the price of the item in each box. Write the total cost in factored form to show the cost of one box.
The total length of 5 equal fence sections is 5x + 40 feet. Write the total length in factored form to show the length of one section.

solutionSteps: (b) Multiply the two factors: 1.2 · 1.5 = 1.8. The final price is 1.8p. Percent changes applied one after another multiply; they do not add.
(c) Both terms are divisible by 3. 3x + 6 = 3·x + 3·2 = 3(x + 2). One box costs x + 2.
(d) Both terms are divisible by 5. 5x + 40 = 5·x + 5·8 = 5(x + 8). One section is x + 8.
